spanish: Todo partiente pezuña y hendiente hendidura de pezuñas, subiente rumia en el animal, a ella comerán.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated English word "cud" with the Spanish common noun "rumia" for H1625, per the cited fail.

Left "subiente" governing its object "rumia" unchanged: Spanish "subir" takes a direct object transitively, so subiente + rumia already carries the causative (hiphil) sense the warn questioned; no calque swap was needed.
readerNote: Kept subiente + rumia as a transitive, causative reading of subir rather than rewording, since the auditor's concern was only that the calque weakly carried causative force, not that it named the wrong clause role.
